title: campanula sibirica subsp. taurica
intro: Campanula sibirica subsp. taurica, commonly known as Tauric Bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Campanula sibirica subsp. taurica include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
